name: Flamel de Qiji
source:
Flamel’s Miracle - a visual novel adventure, choose your own destiny!

New Journey, new world, ancient alchemy, travel companion’s objectives...
In this undiscovered new planet, who is guiding us to our final destination?

Assistant and the protagonist headed to a newly discovered Plane world for new resouces. 
Unfortunately, they ran into worm hole, due to which the spacecraft were forced to make emergency landing onto an unknown world.
In order to fix the spacecraft, the protagonist started adventure and met three girls.
For different purposes though, they travelled along and got involved into various accidents and incidents, voluntarily or not...
Finally, could the protagonist make his way back to where he was from with assistant？

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/599480/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《弗拉梅尔的奇迹》是一部视觉小说冒险作品，你的命运由自己选择！

新的旅程，新的世界，古老炼金术，旅伴各自的目标……
在这颗尚未被探索的行星上，究竟是谁在引导我们前往最终目的地？

助手与主人公前往新发现的平面世界，寻找新的资源。
不幸的是，他们遇上了虫洞，飞船被迫在一颗未知世界上紧急降落。

为了修好飞船，主人公踏上冒险之旅，并遇见三名女孩。三人出于不同目的与他同行，无论自愿与否，都卷入了各种事故与事件……

最后，主人公能回到自己原本的世界吗？

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/599480/]Steam[/url]]
